text:
sam: heads-up: production embeddings are failing for a small fraction of short inputs — token-mapper returns an empty list and downstream embedder errors out. Observed ~5% error rate starting ~03:10 UTC. I prepared a micro patch to default-empty -> ['<unk>']. Need expedited approval to push during 04:00-05:00 change window.

maria: can you drop the exact files changed + risk summary here? i'll prep release note if low risk.

sam: Files: `pkg/embed/token_mapper.py` (one guard), tests added. No proto/model changes. Risk: minimal functional change, affects only empty-token path which currently causes immediate 500s. Rollout plan: canary 10% (5m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (5m). Monitoring: embedder.errors, embed_latency_p95, user-facing 5xx.

chandra: infra ok with that plan. Do we need DB/migration?

sam: no DB. Image only.

ops-oncall: I can standby for rollback. If canary error rate >1% for two consecutive 5m windows, i'll initiate rollback. Need the `kubectl` revert command and the deploybot approval token.

release-manager: post a short public-facing blurb and the internal revert command. I'll act as approver once docs + ops confirm.

sam: Blurb: "Fix: placeholder tokens for empty tokenization to prevent embedding failures in prod."

sam: Revert: `kubectl set image deploy/embedder embedder=embedder:2026.04.01-prev`

sam: deploybot: request approval: image=`embedder:2026.04.01-hotfix-tokenguard` policy=`10/5,50/10,100/5` tag=`urgent-hotfix`

deploybot: @sam request queued. Approvals required: release-manager, ops-oncall, one eng lead. React with :thumbsup: or reply `approve`. Approval TTL: 30m.

nathan: approve — ran CI + quick smoke, branch tests green.

maria: approve from release note side. Posted blurb to notes page and queued customer banner.

release-manager: approve. Note: watch `embedder.errors` and `frontend.5xx_rate` during canary.

ops-oncall: approve. I'll be at console 04:10-04:50 and will cut traffic if anomalies.

deploybot: Approvals complete. Scheduled rollout at 04:15 UTC. Deployment id `deploy-1748504322-b2`. Canary 10% for 5m -> 50% 10m -> 100% 5m.

sam: Pushing image now. Will post digest once available.

sam: Image pushed: `sha256:8c9b...5d2f`. Triggering deploybot.

deploybot: Trigger accepted. Canary started. Notifying SLO and alerting channels.

ops-oncall: Canary 5m update: errors 0.4%, latency unchanged. advancing to 50%.

chandra: infra signals green. continuing watch for 20m post-final rollout.

maria: customer banner sent to affected users, will follow up if we need to rollback.

sam: thanks all. if anyone spots regressions tag thread `deploy-1748504322` and ping oncall.

deploybot: Rollout complete at 04:36 UTC. No rollback required. Closing deployment.

release-manager: marked for 48h post-deploy observation. will open postmortem if any drift appears. :white_check_mark:
